observation: Front, top and iso re-inspected after reducing the crescent so it clears the king plateau edge by 2.0 mm instead of 1.0 mm. Plain round disc, perfectly circular outline with no tail, tab, notch or projection. The crescent now sits as a separate mark on the plateau with an unbroken flat band all round it, rather than running into the annular rebate. Both horns still end in flat square tips and the crescent keeps its 3.5 mm waist. Same mark on both faces.
